title: KAITO — Delicious Pancakes For Everyone!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
All of you!
Sing like you're gonna surpass it today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They're really riding the wave that Arata created for them.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes, but that's not all.
They're trying to take everyone even higher.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes.
Keep in mind that Akito and the others are trying to surpass that “legendary night”.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I was having so much fun just watching that it was over before I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Before the show, they seemed to be dealing with quite a lot, but I'm glad to see that they managed to overcome all of that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Does that mean my advice helped?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What?! That's all?
I thought it was really good advice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You aren't guaranteed to end up with delicious pancakes just because you gathered up some good ingredients!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You have to mix the batter well and cook them right to get them to be nice and fluffy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe events are no different. It can only become good after you've all mixed together and reached an understanding with one another.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... I didn't realize you had given them that sort of advice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I had no idea either.
Honestly, I was too busy preparing for our own event...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I was too busy getting tangled up in cords!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But you may be right, KAITO.
Your advice may be the reason why their event went so well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. It was a great event.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wasn't it?! I can't get myself to sit still after seeing something like that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO, what's the big deal?!
Don't scare us like that...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The thing is, I just remembered that I hadn't finished setting up the equipment we'll be using during our event tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What?!
I thought you finished all that before we went over to see the event!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry, it must've slipped my mind.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, is everything gonna be okay?
Do you think you'll finish in time for tomorrow's event?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, about that...
It may be a bit difficult to make that happen on my own.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You're kidding, right?!
That means we gotta get cracking now!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Based on what I saw, the equipment seemed all set up and ready to go...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
They looked ready to me too.
I mean, KAITO, you hardly ever forget to run setups for anything equipment related.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Could it be that “equipment setup” is a cover for something else...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: For example, he may just want to sing while gathering us under the guise of having to set up all the equipment...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He even said that he was having trouble sitting still after seeing that event.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(How did MEIKO know?!
She's way too sharp!)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, I really need to go check on the equipment.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It'd be nice to sing with all of you while making adjustments, but that's not absolutely necessary...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Looks like we have no choice.
Everyone, let's head over for a final check. We wouldn't want KAITO to have actually missed anything now, would we?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. Why don't we jump straight into a rehearsal right after that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since that's been settled, let's head back over to the cafe, my forgetful fellows!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Also, you're the only forgetful one here, KAITO!
